DuplicateRule.alertText: This person may already be in your database. Look at the records below before you save a second one.
DuplicateRule.description: Warns when a contact being saved looks like somebody the org already has, and records the pair so it can be reviewed later in Nonprofit Settings, Duplicates. It warns and never blocks: a person at the front desk taking a gift over the phone has to be able to save (canonical model R-DP1). Ships inactive, because a matching rule is deployed inactive and a duplicate rule cannot be active until the matching rule it names is.
